hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean control bar with decent typographic hierarchy and intentional button states, but the circle pack layout overflows the viewport in the screenshot — circles and edge bundles are cropped at the bottom, which is a concrete 'does it work at rendered size' failure — and the orange/gray color split is functional but not harmonious.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correct throughout: scaleSqrt for force-layout node radii (line 513) and partition radial scale (line 660), pack layout delegates to d3.pack which is area-correct, key functions present in data joins (d => d.id), and all scale domains are data-driven via d3.extent — no bar/area baseline violations apply to this topology-focused chart.
flags: Mid-Flight Snap: no explicit .interrupt() before new transitions — relies on D3 auto-interruption; rapid layout switching can leave old on('end') FPS-counter state racing with the new transition's RAF
Mouse-Touch: force-simulation drag handler has no touch-event filtering (no !event.sourceEvent or event.type checks), risking double-trigger on touch devices
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Tension slider is correctly RAF-throttled and there are no infinite loops or stale scale closures, but the absence of explicit .interrupt() calls and touch-event guards are meaningful robustness gaps.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle pack hierarchy reads clearly with a restrained two-tone palette, but the edge bundle overlay at low tension fans into a dense tangle of crossing curves across the center that is difficult to trace without hover interaction.
